title: API Registry (api registry add/list/show/remove)
description: Implement the local API Registry — a named catalogue of Zoho API endpoints with base URL, method, URL template, and purpose. Enables shorthand api call --id <id> in a future iteration and provides agents with discoverable endpoint metadata.
prerequisiteState: All v1 stories (1-8) completed. ApiClient is working. The registry.json storage file and ApiRegistryEntry model do not exist yet.
goal: api registry add, list, show, and remove correctly persist named endpoint entries to <configDir>/registry.json. All four commands produce valid JSON output.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Registry/ApiRegistryEntry.cs as a sealed record with Id, BaseUrl, Method, UrlTemplate, Purpose properties
Create src/ZapiCli.Core/Registry/ApiRegistry.cs: reads/writes <configDir>/registry.json; methods: AddOrUpdateAsync, ListAsync, FindAsync, RemoveAsync
Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/ApiRegistryCommands.cs with ApiRegistryAddCommand, ApiRegistryListCommand, ApiRegistryShowCommand, ApiRegistryRemoveCommand
ApiRegistryListCommand: returns all entries as JSON array; exits 0 even if empty
ApiRegistryShowCommand: --id (req); throws REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND (exit 1) if not found
ApiRegistryRemoveCommand: --id (req); deletes entry; throws REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND if not found
Register all four commands under 'api registry' branch in Program.cs (nested under the existing 'api' branch)

Unit tests: add → list shows new entry; show returns entry; show missing → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; remove deletes entry; remove missing → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND; add with existing id updates (upsert)
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
api registry add --id desk-list-tickets --base-url https://desk.zoho.com/api/v1 --method GET --url-template /tickets --purpose 'List all Desk tickets' creates the entry in registry.json
api registry list returns all entries as a JSON array; exits 0 if empty
api registry show --id desk-list-tickets returns the matching entry
api registry show --id nonexistent → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND, exit 1
api registry remove --id desk-list-tickets removes the entry
api registry remove --id nonexistent → REGISTRY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND, exit 1
api registry add with an existing id updates (upserts) the entry
contextForAgent: Read prd.json FR-013 for the API Registry design. Each registry entry carries a baseUrl field to support multi-product entries in oneregistry. The registry.json is a flat list of ApiRegistryEntry objects. No host allowlist validation is applied at registry add time — the allowlist only fires at api call dispatch.
sourceReferences: tech_spec/prd.md (§ FR-013 API Registry, § commandTree v2additions)
